thread:
maya: Heads up — outgoing pages for notify-ingress failing since ~12:13 UTC, multiple customers reporting missed pages. incidentbot shows messages as dispatched but downstream proxy logs a bunch of 5xx.

ops-bot: ALERT: notify-ingress webhook error rate spike (5xx) — ~18% failures in last 10m :warning:

jon: looking now

inc-bot: [system] 12:14 UTC webhook-queue depth increased to 1200 (baseline ~40)

maya: quick repro with curl to the pager proxy shows timeout/504: 
```
$ curl -v https://pager-proxy.internal/api/send -d '{"to":"oncall"}'
* Connection timed out after 5000 ms
```

aline: I can manual-page the oncall from my phone. @sre-oncall can you confirm whether any pages actually landed?

sre-oncall: nothing received on SMS or push. please manual-page until we have a fix.

jon: digging into proxy logs — seeing TLS handshake failures to pager-proxy-hosts and connection resets. error sample: `tls: handshake failure`

harry: that matches the secret rotation job that ran at ~11:58. looks like some proxy instances picked up the new cert chain and others didn't. may be a compatibility issue with the pager vendor.

maya: manual escalation done — I paged the oncall via carrier SMS and posted in the ops bridge. customers notified for impacted pages.

jon: rolling back proxy certs now, and rolling webproxy image to previous stable. running: `kubectl set image deploy/webproxy webproxy=webproxy:v2.3.1` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/webproxy`

ops-bot: deploy bot: rollout started for deployment/webproxy -> revision v2.3.1

jon: logs after restart show queue draining and successful sends: 
```
INFO webhook-sender: connection established to pager-proxy-01
INFO queue: send success 200 for msg id=abc123
```

sre-oncall: Received test page at 12:27 UTC. Confirmed end-to-end delivery. Preliminary customer-impact estimate: ~22 missed pages during window, will validate with logs.

aline: Opening follow-up GH issue to track fixes and blameless postmortem: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/4321 — items: (1) add healthcheck to incidentbot to detect 5xx surge and mute/handoff when downstream rejects, (2) prevent automatic cert rotation for pager proxy without staged rollout, (3) add canary for outbound TLS changes.

jon: will own the postmortem. also will add a quick automated fallback in incidentbot to use SMS bridge when webhook error rate > 10% for > 2m.

maya: thanks everyone. marking this thread as resolved for now, will update once postmortem is posted. :white_check_mark:
